footer.mockDemo: Mock data demo — no live Riot data is used.

landing.headline: Review your VALORANT Premier matches
landing.subhead: Your team. Your opponents. Your positions. Turn every Premier match you play into clear, honest analytics.

features.heading: Built for the matches you play

analytics.title: Team & player analytics
analytics.body: Win rate, form, K/D, plant and clutch trends across your roster — at a glance and over time.

positional.title: Positional kill / plant maps
positional.body: See where rounds are won and lost. Kill locations, spike plants, and site control mapped per match.

opponent.title: Opponent review
opponent.body: Based on matches you've played — break down the teams you've already faced, round by round.

landing.trust: We only ever show matches you've played — no opponent search, no lookup.

connect.title: Connect your Riot account
connect.intro: Sign in once with Riot Sign-On. We read your own Premier match history — nothing else.

read.label: What we read
read.body: Your own Premier match history, via Riot Sign-On.

show.label: What we show
show.body: Your team, and the opponents you've personally played — based on the matches you played in.

how.label: How it works
how.body: A single team captain signs in; we reconstruct the team from your matches. We never look up arbitrary players — there's no search.

connect.consent: I agree to share my Premier match data per the Privacy Policy

riot.title: Riot Sign On
riot.banner: Simulated login — no real Riot credentials are used. This is a demo.
riot.fieldsNote: These fields are inactive — the demo doesn't collect or send any credentials.
